scope: software-only: course hip soft limits, S3 board name, typed joint directions and saved-calibration compatibility; no flashing and no physical device operations

stored_limits.before: Calibration::valid() compared stored limits with SOFT_LOW/SOFT_HIGH. Under the narrower soft limits that rule would have refused any record holding the earlier hip limits on load, and the firmware would have started from defaults.
stored_limits.now: A record is validated for structure only (limits within 0..180 containing 90). A stored limit wider than the manifest soft limit is loaded as saved, bounds that joint's commands as saved, and is named at boot and by show. Nothing is clamped or written to NVS on load. An explicit save stores the same values under the current identity. A new limits edit outside the soft range is refused and changes nothing.
